```artifact
Feature: Services and Access within Padmavathi Hospital Zone
  Background: When a patient is within the specified zone around Padmavathi Hospital
  
  Scenario: Patients can register and apply for appointments/consultation requests
    Given a patient is within the 25 sqkm radius of Padmavathi Hospital
    When the patient attempts to register and apply for an appointment
    Then the system should allow the registration and appointment application process
    
  Scenario: Chemist availability and delivery within the zone
    Given a patient with a matching Pincode to a Chemist's location
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should route the prescription to the Chemist
    
  Scenario: Chemist delivery and payment collection
    Given a patient with a matching Pincode to a Chemist' extraneous to the zone
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should route the prescription to the Chemist and expect delivery
    
  Scenario: Chemist marks prescription completion
    Given a Chemist has delivered a prescription
    When the Chemist completes the delivery
    Then the system should mark the prescription as completed
    
  Scenario: Laboratory services within the zone
    Given a patient with a matching Pincode to a Laboratory's location
    When the patient requests a test
    Then the system should route the request to the Laboratory
    
  Scenario: No systemic matching for Chemist efficiency
    Given any patient requests a prescription
    When the system routes the prescription
    Then there should be no systemic matching to determine Chemist efficiency
    
  Scenario: Exclusivity of zone registration
    Given a patient outside the zone
    When the patient attempts to register
    Then the system should deny registration
    
  Scenario: Chemist availability per Pincode
    Given a patient with a Pincode matching multiple Chemists
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should clarify which Chemist to route the prescription to
    
  Scenario: Chemist operates 24/7
    Given it is outside business hours
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should confirm the Chemist's 24/7 availability
    
  Scenario: Laboratory availability per Pincode
    Given a patient with a Pincode matching multiple Laboratories
    When the patient requests a test
    Then the system should clarify which Laboratory to route the request to
    
  Scenario: Boundary conditions for radius
    Given a patient exactly at the 25 sqkm boundary
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should treat the patient as within the zone
    
  Scenario: Boundary conditions for Chemist availability
    Given a patient during peak hours
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should confirm the Chemist's 24/7 availability
    
  Scenario: Boundary conditions for Laboratory routing
    Given a patient during off-peak hours
    When the patient requests a test
    Then the system should confirm the Laboratory's availability
    
  Scenario: No negative test for patients outside the zone
    Given a patient outside the 25 sqkm radius
    When the patient attempts to request a prescription
    Then the system should deny the request and inform the patient of the zone boundary
    
  Scenario: Ensuring exclusivity of zone registration
    Given a patient attempts to register outside the zone
    When the patient is denied registration
    Then the system should provide a clear explanation of the zone boundary
    
  Scenario: Verification of single Chemist per Pincode
    Given a patient with a Pincode matching one Chemist
    When the patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should confirm the routing to the correct Chemist
    
  Scenario: Verification of single Laboratory per Pincode
    Given a patient with a Pincode matching one Laboratory
    When the patient requests a test
    Then the system should confirm the routing to the correct Laboratory
```
